itens.trecho: Já começo minha impressão sobre o filme fazendo uma comparação... Assim como o cantor Naldo Beny, a franquia de Velozes e Furiosos cai nas graças do povo. A grande massa solta as frases clássicas como , " Filme mentiroso"; "filme exagerado" ; "Vin Diesel faz os filmes terminarem em um grande churrasco em família".

Writing a review for a sequel like “Fast X” feels pretty pointless. It’s the type of adrenaline-fueled blockbuster that rabid fans will eagerly shell out money to see and want to love, while snobby critics will begrudgingly watch with a chip on their shoulder combined with a predetermined disdain for whatever will unfold.

This was, of course, a totally ludicrous movie devoid of any pretense of realism or intelligence when it comes to basic science and physics from the script writers. It was however, also a quite fun movie. It is also a movie free from the usual Hollywood far left woke preaching which is, of course, a big plus.
